registers.name: dvp_version
registers.description: DVP controller version register. Identifies the major and minor software interface revision.

fields.name: major
fields.description:
Major IP version number. Software reads this value to select a compatible driver.

Usage: Read during initialization; software never writes this field.

Values:
0x1 major version 1 (reset value).

Unit: none

Limits: 16-bit unsigned version number.

fields.name: minor
fields.description:
Minor IP version number. Software reads this value to identify compatible interface additions.

Usage: Read with the major version during initialization; software never writes this field.

Values:
0x1 minor version 1 (reset value).

Unit: none

Limits: 16-bit unsigned version number.

registers.name: dvp_ctrl
registers.description: DVP controller control register. Enables or disables qualified sensor sample capture.

fields.name: capture_en
fields.description:
Capture enable bit. Allows frame-qualified DVP samples to enter the FIFO selected by pclk_mode.

Usage: Program PCLK_MODE, watermark and timeout before enabling. Capture arms at the next active VSYNC edge after the selected path is initialized; clear to stop accepting new samples. Existing FIFO entries remain available to DMA.

Values:
0x0 capture disabled (reset value);
0x1 capture enabled.

Unit: none

Limits: One-bit value.

fields.name: pclk_mode
fields.description:
PCLK clock-mode selector. Selects the continuous-PCLK AFIFO path or gated valid-pixel toggle/SFIFO path.

Usage: Program in a separate APB write while capture is disabled and before enabling capture. Writes while capture is enabled or when the same write sets capture_en are ignored; APB completes with OKAY. Keep mode unchanged for a capture session.

Values:
0x0 Continuous PCLK with asynchronous Gray FIFO (reset value);
0x1 Gated PCLK with valid-pixel toggle bridge and APB-clocked FIFO.

Unit: none

Limits: One-bit runtime CSR field; see the PCLK spacing and VSYNC pulse requirements in the hardware specification.

fields.name: fifo_flush
fields.description:
FIFO flush request and pending indicator. A software write of one requests reset of the FIFO selected by pclk_mode; hardware clears the field after the FIFO reset handshake completes.

Usage: Disable capture and stop DMA APB reads, write one, then poll until hardware clears it. Do not start capture, change PCLK_MODE, or issue FIFO_DATA reads while the bit is one. Keep i_clk_dvp running for a continuous-mode flush. A write while capture is enabled is ignored; a write while a request is pending cannot cancel the operation.

Values:
0x0 no flush pending (reset value);
0x1 flush pending/in progress.

Unit: none

Limits: One-bit RWI field; only the selected FIFO is reset; frame count and sticky overflow are retained.

registers.name: dvp_wmark
registers.description: DVP FIFO watermark register. Selects the occupancy that requests a DMA service batch.

fields.name: level
fields.description:
FIFO watermark level. Raises the DMA batch request when read-side occupancy reaches this sample count.

Usage: Program before enabling capture; zero disables DMA requests; use a value no greater than PARA_FIFO_DEPTH.

Values:
0x0 DMA request disabled (reset value);
0x1 to 0xFFFFFFFF request at or above the programmed occupancy, subject to FIFO depth.

Unit: sample entries

Limits: Zero disables requests; valid nonzero values are 1 through PARA_FIFO_DEPTH; values greater than the physical depth are unreachable thresholds and leave the request deasserted.

registers.name: dvp_timeout
registers.description: DVP FIFO timeout register. Bounds APB wait cycles for reads of an empty FIFO-data endpoint.

fields.name: cycles
fields.description:
FIFO-empty timeout. Limits the APB access cycles an empty FIFO-data read may wait before returning PSLVERR.

Usage: Reset default is the longest supported wait. Software may program a smaller value before DMA reads; zero gives an immediate error in the first access cycle when FIFO is empty. Data available on the terminal decision cycle wins.

Values:
0x0 immediate empty-read timeout;
0x1 to 0xFFFFFFFF wait the programmed number of APB access cycles;
0xFFFFFFFF reset value and maximum timeout.

Unit: APB clock cycles

Limits: 32-bit unsigned count; applies only while a FIFO-data read is active and the FIFO is empty.

registers.name: dvp_fifo_sts
registers.description: DVP FIFO status register. Reports capture state, selected FIFO flags and sticky overflow.

fields.name: active
fields.description:
Capture armed/active status. Reports that capture is enabled and the selected path has observed its qualifying VSYNC frame boundary.

Usage: Read to determine whether the controller is collecting samples from the current frame.

Values:
0x0 capture disabled or waiting for a qualifying VSYNC;
0x1 capture active.

Unit: none

Limits: One-bit APB-domain status; gated mode waits for synchronized VSYNC and qualified pixel timing.

fields.name: empty
fields.description:
FIFO empty status. Reports that no sample is available in the FIFO selected by pclk_mode.

Usage: Read before or after DMA service; a value of one means FIFO_DATA reads will wait or time out.

Values:
0x0 not empty;
0x1 empty (reset value after coordinated FIFO reset).

Unit: none

Limits: Mode 0 uses the APB read-side AFIFO flag; mode 1 uses the APB SFIFO flag. Status is valid after the selected path initializes.

fields.name: full
fields.description:
FIFO full status. Reports that the FIFO selected by pclk_mode cannot accept another sample.

Usage: Read while capture is active to monitor overflow risk; the sensor itself cannot be stalled.

Values:
0x0 not full (reset value);
0x1 full.

Unit: none

Limits: Mode 0 AFIFO full indication is synchronized to APB; mode 1 SFIFO full is local to APB.

fields.name: ovf
fields.description:
FIFO overflow event. Sticky flag records a qualified sample rejected because the FIFO was full.

Usage: Read after capture; write one to clear after software records or handles the sample loss; a new hardware event wins over a simultaneous clear.

Values:
0x0 no recorded overflow (reset value);
0x1 overflow recorded.

Unit: none

Limits: One-bit sticky status; hardware sets it from the mode-specific overflow event; continuous-mode pulse is synchronized to APB.

registers.name: dvp_fifo_level
registers.description: DVP FIFO level register. Reports occupancy of the FIFO selected by dvp_ctrl.pclk_mode.

fields.name: count
fields.description:
Selected FIFO occupancy in sample entries.

Usage: Read before servicing a DMA batch or while diagnosing overflow risk. The same value feeds the watermark request logic.

Values:
0x0 no samples available (reset value);
0x1 to PARA_FIFO_DEPTH current visible entries.

Unit: sample entries

Limits: Mode 0 is the APB read-side AFIFO estimate and can lag new PCLK writes by CDC latency. Mode 1 is the exact APB-domain accepted-write/read count.

registers.name: dvp_frame_count
registers.description: DVP frame counter. Counts accepted active VSYNC frame-start events while capture is enabled.

fields.name: count
fields.description:
Accepted frame-start count. Increments once when an active VSYNC edge is accepted by the selected capture path while CAPTURE_EN is one. Continuous-mode events cross from PCLK to CLK-APB through the event synchronizer; gated-mode events are detected in CLK-APB.

Usage: Read to monitor completed frame starts; software may calculate a delta modulo 2^32. The counter is not cleared by FIFO flush.

Values:
0x0 no accepted frame start since reset (reset value);
0x1 to 0xFFFFFFFF modulo-2^32 frame count.

Unit: frames

Limits: 32-bit unsigned counter; wraps from 0xFFFFFFFF to 0x00000000 and is cleared only by common reset.
